cards.front: life cycle
cards.back: The stages a living thing goes through, from birth to being grown up and having young.
cards.say: life cycle. The stages a living thing goes through, from birth to being grown up and having young.

cards.front: egg
cards.back: The first stage for many animals, like birds, frogs and butterflies.
cards.say: egg. The first stage for many animals, like birds, frogs and butterflies.

cards.front: larva
cards.back: The young stage of some insects. A caterpillar is the larva of a butterfly.
cards.say: larva. The young stage of some insects. A caterpillar is the larva of a butterfly.

cards.front: pupa
cards.back: The stage when a caterpillar changes inside a hard case into a butterfly.
cards.say: pupa. The stage when a caterpillar changes inside a hard case into a butterfly.

cards.front: tadpole
cards.back: The young stage of a frog. It lives in water and has a tail.
cards.say: tadpole. The young stage of a frog. It lives in water and has a tail.

cards.front: What are the stages of a butterfly life cycle?
cards.back: Egg, caterpillar, pupa, butterfly.
cards.say: What are the stages of a butterfly life cycle? Egg, caterpillar, pupa, butterfly.

cards.front: What comes out of a butterfly egg?
cards.back: A caterpillar.
cards.say: What comes out of a butterfly egg? A caterpillar.

cards.front: What does a caterpillar do most of the time?
cards.back: It eats leaves and grows.
cards.say: What does a caterpillar do most of the time? It eats leaves and grows.

cards.front: What does a caterpillar become?
cards.back: It becomes a pupa, and then a butterfly.
cards.say: What does a caterpillar become? It becomes a pupa, and then a butterfly.

cards.front: What are the stages of a frog life cycle?
cards.back: Egg (called frogspawn), tadpole, young frog, adult frog.
cards.say: What are the stages of a frog life cycle? Egg (called frogspawn), tadpole, young frog, adult frog.

cards.front: What does a tadpole grow into?
cards.back: A frog.
cards.say: What does a tadpole grow into? A frog.

cards.front: Which legs does a tadpole grow first, back legs or front legs?
cards.back: Back legs.
cards.say: Which legs does a tadpole grow first, back legs or front legs? Back legs.

cards.front: What are the stages of a chicken life cycle?
cards.back: Egg, chick, adult hen or cockerel.
cards.say: What are the stages of a chicken life cycle? Egg, chick, adult hen or cockerel.

cards.front: What comes out of a hen egg?
cards.back: A chick.
cards.say: What comes out of a hen egg? A chick.

cards.front: What are the stages of a plant life cycle?
cards.back: Seed, small plant, adult plant with flowers, new seeds.
cards.say: What are the stages of a plant life cycle? Seed, small plant, adult plant with flowers, new seeds.

cards.front: What does a seed grow into?
cards.back: A new plant.
cards.say: What does a seed grow into? A new plant.

cards.front: What makes seeds in a plant?
cards.back: The flower.
cards.say: What makes seeds in a plant? The flower.

cards.front: What are the stages of a human life cycle?
cards.back: Baby, child, teenager, adult, older person.
cards.say: What are the stages of a human life cycle? Baby, child, teenager, adult, older person.

cards.front: Which stage comes first in a human life cycle?
cards.back: Baby.
cards.say: Which stage comes first in a human life cycle? Baby.

cards.front: Which stage comes after a child?
cards.back: A teenager.
cards.say: Which stage comes after a child? A teenager.

cards.front: Which comes first, the egg or the adult?
cards.back: The egg. A life cycle starts with an egg or a baby.
cards.say: Which comes first, the egg or the adult? The egg. A life cycle starts with an egg or a baby.

cards.front: Does a puppy grow into a kitten?
cards.back: No. A puppy grows into a dog.
cards.say: Does a puppy grow into a kitten? No. A puppy grows into a dog.

cards.front: Which animals lay eggs: dogs or birds?
cards.back: Birds. Dogs give birth to puppies.
cards.say: Which animals lay eggs: dogs or birds? Birds. Dogs give birth to puppies.
